name: @csa-loom/health-dicom-gateway
description: CSA Loom Health Data Services DICOMweb gateway (LHDS W3-3): the only path to the per-tenant dcm4chee archive. Authorizes every request through the PDP (fail closed), audits every interaction, streams STOW/WADO without buffering. Holds no clinical data. Azure-native; no Microsoft Fabric dependency.
